content: JESUS EḎUA HIBAIṮOM
Juda dilag Meṯid amu uḵa male, Maria, Magdala ted, nug buṯuanab gatatu ele moḏp̱a uḵa, men naḏi moḏ ameg tonom amu laa nug duṯune uḵa, moḏ amegp̱a ii dayeye anṯom.
Anam anṯa, nug eḏua qaibaḏ uḵa, Simon Petrus amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab laa, Jesus Nug nuhignu oo huanak mauhṯom ele amu, a amelahp̱a aum. “Ag Naḏi aon, adebtag mep̱ig amu ig ii dooṯem,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Petrus, ip̱uniṯak awak danab laa ele a ahai, moḏp̱a goḵulahnu
qaibaḏ gopiḏ. Goyaya amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab laa amu nug Petrus eḏiṯa, nug tatam moḏ guguiṯa uḵom.
Nug uḵa ta, gomela neeḵe, moḏ oop̱a uḵe amu nug lamen elab, ag amup̱a Jesus gaḏa itap̱ig ele amu nug amuib niieye anṯom amge nug oop̱a ii noum.
Nug anam neeḵa dayeye, dimp̱a Simon Petrus nug uḵa ta, nug ip̱u meṯa, moḏ oop̱a uḵa, nug ele linen lamen amu anṯa,
nug lamen laa, ag lamen amup̱a Jesus iḵi hautp̱ig ele amu, nug lamen amu ele anṯom. Lamen amu qak dayom bia nuḵa anam dayeye, linen lamen ele amu nug ele nuḵa dayeye anṯom.
Anam anṯe amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab nug tatam men moḏp̱a uḵom ele amu, nug ele oop̱a noa anṯa, nug oop̱a genab doyom.
A amelahp̱anab anam anidya, a Kayak naip̱a, Jesus Nug eḏua hip̱aidḵunu nai amu yak daaṯe amu a amunu oolah ii maiṯom.
A anam anṯoya amu ip̱uniṯak awak danab aḏit a eḏuya laulahp̱a gopiḏ.
MAGDALA AH MARIA JESUS ANṮOM
Ip̱uniṯak awak danab aḏit uḵaeheh, Maria nug dimiṯim hibaiṯa, gayaya dayaya, nug gomela neeḵe, men moḏ oop̱a uḵom.
Neeḵe uḵe amu engel aḏit, lamen haḵab ele, Jesus gaḏa niiom aben amup̱a laa igip̱a laa baegp̱a anam daaeheh anatom.
Anate, a nug amegp̱a apiḏ. “Ah na aḏinu gaaṯem?” aoya apiḏ. Anam aeh amu nug aum. “Danab ag dahil Naḏi aon adebtag gop̱ig, adebtag mep̱ig, da ii dooṯem,” awa aum.
Nug anam anana, nug eḏua amu Jesus hibaiṯa dayeye anṯom amge Nug am Jesus amu nug ii doyom.

Ah nug eḏua Jesus anṯe amu Jesus ah oḏ meṯom. “Ah, na aḏinu gaaṯem? Aun madiṯem?” oḏ meṯa aum. Oḏ meṯe amu ah nug danab amu nug dad amu mamegtai anana amu amegp̱a aum. “Danab naḏi, natai aon gome? Anam dayeb amu na adep̱a meme amu da amelp̱a ap̱e, da uḵen aoḵul,” awa aum.
Anam a amu Jesus eḏua ah onig diia, “Maria,” awa aum. Anam a amu ah nug eḏua Hibru naip̱a, “Rabonai,” awa aum. Amu diig am, “Ip̱uniṯak danab.”

Nug anam a amu Jesus aum. “Na da aib aḏailme, da Mame top̱a ii gomi. Amge na da oḏel aona, da lailad gumadna gona, amelagp̱a inam a! ‘Da, da Mamel, Nug am ag Mamelag ele, da dahil Kayak amu ahilag Kayak ele amu, da Nug gumiṯe goṯem,’” awa aum.
Jesus anam amegp̱a a amu Maria, Magdala ted, nug uḵa, ip̱uniṯak awak danab amelagp̱a aum. “Da Naḏi anidmi,” awa aum. Anana amu nai Jesus nug amegp̱a aum amu oh amelagp̱a aum.

Aria deḏ amup̱aib Meṯidp̱a gatatu ne, Jesusnu ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag Juda dilag oḵai baḏadna, lag od manon daaegeg, Jesus uḏia tula, ag gumaṯa doa dayaya, ag amelagp̱a aum. “Ag oo mak maḏoḏ ele aweg!” awa aum.
Nug anam awowa amu Nug ep̱eg, qeṯi ele ip̱uanaṯom. Ag Naḏi anidna amu ag oolag gamag ahak oḵai doop̱ig.
Ag oolag gamag ahe amu Jesus baula amelagp̱a aum. “Ag oo mak maḏoḏ ele aweg! Mame Nug da meiḏe uḏimi, amubia da ele ag maaṯi goṯeb,” awa aum.
Anam awowa, Nug ouḏi ahilagp̱a iwala, Nug aum. “Ag Kayak Ouḏi aweg!
Ag danab dilag hip̱unin op̱ina maṯaglag amu danab amu dilag hip̱unin iiṯa meḵulag. Ag ii op̱ina maṯaglag amu danab amu dilag hip̱unin iiṯa ii memana,” awa aum.
Haen amup̱a ip̱uniṯak awak danab laa Tomas, nuhignu ag Didimas ele aṯeb amu, nug ag ele ii daaegeg, Jesus Nug uḏiom

amunu ip̱uniṯak awak danab laiḵud laa ag Naḏi anidp̱ignu amegp̱a aeg, nug aum. “Ag Nug ep̱eg tutuip̱a atulp̱ig amunu duḏup̱a amu da amelp̱a anṯena, da duḏup̱a amu ep̱elp̱a aḏen, Nug qeṯi duḏup̱a ele ep̱elp̱a aḏe doyena amu da oolp̱a genab dooḵul,” awa aum.

Nug anam a dimp̱a meṯid laip̱u uue, ip̱uniṯak awak danab ag baula Meṯidp̱a laḵa qag mena daanna, haen amup̱a Tomas nug ele oh daap̱ig. Ag daanna, lag od oh amu manaṯon daap̱ig amge Jesus Nug uḏia oolagp̱a dayaya aum. “Ag oo mak maḏoḏ ele aweg!”

Anam awowa, Nug Tomas amegp̱a aum. “Na ep̱en doḏop̱a da ep̱el nakok aḏan, amenp̱a ele da ep̱el anṯe! Na ep̱en bahin, da qeṯil ele nakok aḏe! Na oop̱a genab ii doyak danab bia aib heme. Iiṯa! Na ootp̱a genab doye!” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Tomas oḏep̱a awa aum. “Na dahil Naḏi. Na dahil Kayak!” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Jesus amegp̱a aum. “Na amu amenp̱anab da aniḏna, na ootp̱a genab doome. Laa ag da ii aniḏna, oolagp̱a genab dooṯeb amu, Kayak Nug ag itiṯak madaṯe,” awa aum.
Jesus Nug nuhiḵud ip̱uniṯak awak danab noolagp̱a ep̱onak keeke, danab heḵunu elele iiṯa iḏu iḏu kuḏum laa ele heum amu buk imup̱a oh ii yak.

Amge yak imu daaṯe amu ag eb qenana, ag, Jesus Nug am Kristus, Nug am ele Kayak Beḵa daaṯe, ag amu doona, oolagp̱a genab dooglagnu daaṯe. Ag nuhignu oolagp̱a genab doonna amu ag Nug onigp̱a ag bauklel aoglagnu yak imu amunu ele daaṯe.
